It supports up to 16 channels and offers dual SATA drive bays for flexible storage. To preserve bandwidth and save storage space, it uses Ultra H.265, H.265, and H.264 compression. The device records in resolutions up to 12 MP and supports simultaneous HDMI (up to 4K) and VGA output for live monitoring.
